name: Gmail — Compose via Prefill URL
description: Opens a Gmail compose window pre-filled with to/subject/body using Gmail's prefill URL, instead of clicking Compose and filling fields one by one. Optionally clicks Send. This is the canonical 'prefer a faster path than UI' tool (see docs/Playwright agent.md).

steps.name: compose
steps.description: navigate to the prefill URL and confirm the compose window rendered (idempotent — safe to re-run/resume)

steps.name: send
steps.description: click Send (IRREVERSIBLE). Gated on --send; recorded once done so a resume never re-fires it.

send.description: if set, click Send after composing; otherwise leave the draft open for review

output.composed: true once the compose window is open and prefilled
output.sent: true if --send was given and Send succeeded

dependencies: Requires an authenticated Gmail session in the Breeze browser. Validate login before use.
known_issues: Send button selector relies on aria-label='Send' (English UI). Localized UIs need a different selector.
Very long bodies can exceed URL length limits; for large messages, type into the body field instead.
